when: the request passes the role, the justification and the code (outcome SHOWN)
reason: The entry's words and its bond-day's date are shown in the POST's own response, never cached. The read is one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (SUCCEEDED) and one WORDS_READ row in the report's log, committed with it; the report stays open. A MODERATOR or SUPPORT never reaches this, a wrong code is the form again with nothing read, and every read needs a new code.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#shown writes one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row and the report's WORDS_READ row

reason: No words: the page says its author erased the entry. The read is still audited (SUCCEEDED) and still logs WORDS_READ, because the act completed and read nothing. An open report does not hold the words from their author's erasure or withdrawal.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#an erased entry is SUCCEEDED, read nothing, and is logged WORDS_READ

reason: Nothing is read: the report's page says it was already decided. The attempt is one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED) and no WORDS_READ row; the report is never read once decided. Not this row: a well-formed id that names no report. The port answers NOT_OPEN for it too, but only after the code has been proved and spent; the attempt is one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED) on the REPORT target, and the answer is the 404 page, since there is no report to show.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#each refusal is REFUSED on its target and logs no WORDS_READ

when: the reason the page showed is not the report's reason now (outcome STALE)
reason: Nothing is read: someone reclassified the report after the page was loaded, so the admin is told to read it again. One ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED), no WORDS_READ row.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#each refusal is REFUSED on its target and logs no WORDS_READ

when: a member report, or a report whose reason is NON_CONSENSUAL or MINOR_SEXUAL_CONTENT (outcome NOT_ABOUT_WORDS)
reason: Nothing is read: the page says why (a member report has no entry; an image reason is reclassified first if its detail is about words). This keeps a read off any report that might concern child sexual abuse material. One ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED), no WORDS_READ row.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#each refusal is REFUSED on its target and logs no WORDS_READ

when: at any time while the report is open
reason: The author's right to erase wins: an open report does not hold the words. A withdrawn author's entry reads as erased even before the outbox has emptied the row, so that the admin does not read what the partner can no longer read.
evidenceRef: ReportedEntryTextTest#an entry its author erased is erased, and the read is still logged

when: dismissed, reclassified-and-upheld or upheld by a moderator or an admin (A2)
reason: From then on no one may read its words: the rule needs an OPEN report.
evidenceRef: ReportedEntryTextTest#a report decided first is not open, and nothing is logged

when: a moderator or an admin picks NON_CONSENSUAL or MINOR_SEXUAL_CONTENT (A2)
reason: The reason decides: an image reason is never read as words, whatever its detail.

when: a report on an entry, whose detail shows it is about words (A2)
reason: Reclassified first, then read: the one way an image-reason report's entry is ever read.
evidenceRef: ReportedEntryTextTest#an image reason reclassified to one about words is then shown

reason: One ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED row, SUCCEEDED, the note as its justification and metadata {result, statusBefore, deletionPending}; committed with the act. The flash: "Suspended. They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in. Their bonds are paused.", plus when a deletion the person asked for will run. Before the act, in order: the role (a MODERATOR or SUPPORT gets the 403 page and nothing is read), the id (not a UUID: the 404 page), the justification (ModerationNote: refused, the form again with 422 and no code spent) and the code (proved in this request: blank, the form asking for it; wrong or replayed, 401). Each act needs a code of its own. The answer is a 303 to the lookup with one line, never the note.
evidenceRef: SuspensionConsoleServiceTest#every outcome of a suspend writes one ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED row with exactly its fields

reason: Nothing changes, and the attempt is still one ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED row, REFUSED, result ALREADY_SUSPENDED: a spent code with no act beside it would read as a gap. Two admins at once: the second waits on the locks and gets this.
evidenceRef: AccountSuspensionTest#suspending twice changes nothing the second time

reason: One ACCOUNT_UNSUSPENDED row, SUCCEEDED. The status the account earned (ACTIVE if verified, else PENDING_VERIFICATION); the span closes; no session comes back. The flash: "Suspension lifted. They can sign in again; their bonds take entries again now."
evidenceRef: SuspensionConsoleServiceTest#every outcome of a lift writes one ACCOUNT_UNSUSPENDED row with exactly its fields

reason: Nothing changes; one ACCOUNT_UNSUSPENDED row, REFUSED, result NOT_SUSPENDED. "This account is not suspended. Nothing changed."
evidenceRef: AccountSuspensionTest#lifting an active account is NOT_SUSPENDED and writes nothing

reason: A deleted account (or PENDING_DELETION, which nothing writes) cannot be suspended; one REFUSED row, result GONE. "This account was deleted. There is nothing to suspend."
evidenceRef: AccountSuspensionTest#a deleted account is GONE both ways and nothing is written

reason: The same answer for a lift: one ACCOUNT_UNSUSPENDED row, REFUSED, result GONE.
evidenceRef: AccountSuspensionTest#a deleted account is GONE both ways and nothing is written

reason: A well-formed id that names nobody: the admin 404 page, not a redirect, after the code has been proved and spent. One ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED row, REFUSED, with no target.
evidenceRef: SuspensionControllerTest#NO_SUCH_ACCOUNT is the 404 page, not a redirect, its refusal audited without a target

reason: The same for a lift: the 404 page, one ACCOUNT_UNSUSPENDED row, REFUSED, with no target.
evidenceRef: SuspensionControllerTest#NO_SUCH_ACCOUNT is the 404 page, not a redirect, its refusal audited without a target

when: a deletion the person asked for before the suspension falls due
reason: A pending deletion is carried out on time, suspended or not: the right to erasure is the person's. The span outlives the erasure (dates and an anonymised id), so the partner's bond stays paused until the outbox ends it.
evidenceRef: AccountSuspensionTest#a pending deletion is said with its due instant, and is carried out on time while suspended

when: a deletion the person asked for falls due
reason: The account is erased as before A3; every later suspend or lift is GONE.

The close job runs once, now, under close-days (lockAtMostFor 14 minutes, lockAtLeastFor zero), whether or not the timer is on. Before any work, while the lock is held, one JOB_RUN row, SUCCEEDED, {job: close-days, result: STARTED}, the justification as its justification, commits in its own transaction; a row that cannot be written stops the run. The answer is a 303 to /admin/jobs with "Ran: created N, closed N, revealed N, counted N, failed N." (and "More days are waiting: run it again." on a backlog). Before the act: the role (SUPPORT and MODERATOR get the 403 page) and the justification (ModerationNote: refused, the page again with 422 and no row).
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#an ADMIN runs the close job, a 303 with the counts in the flash, a STARTED row, and its finish on the page

when: the timer or another instance holds the lock
reason: Nothing runs and no beforeRun is called; one JOB_RUN row, REFUSED, {job: close-days, result: BUSY}. The flash: "The close job's lock is held: it is running now, or ran moments ago and holds its lock a little longer (the timer or another instance). Nothing was started; try again in a minute."
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#while the close job's lock is held the run is BUSY, a REFUSED row, and nothing runs

reason: ShedLock's row for close-days is taken until the run ends (at least thirty seconds for the timer's runs).
evidenceRef: JobConsoleTest#while the timer or another instance holds the lock, nothing is called and the answer is busy

when: the run finishes, or lockAtMostFor lapses
reason: The lock is free again. A run by hand releases at once (lockAtLeastFor zero); a ShedLock row is never deleted, only released (ADR-0067 decision 19).
evidenceRef: JobConsoleTest#a run by hand calls beforeRun under the lock, then the closer once, and answers its counts

reason: The flag's row is written disabled, under the flag's advisory lock, with one FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED row, SUCCEEDED, {result: CHANGED, from: true, to: false}. The next run of its job, or the next embedding call, on every instance, sees it: no cache. The flash: "Switched off." Before the act: the role (ADMIN only; others the 403 page), the flag (unknown: the 404 page), enabled (neither true nor false: the 404 page), the justification (422).
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a flag switched off on the page is off for every reader at once, and on again restores them

reason: Nothing is written to the flag; one FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED row, REFUSED, {result: UNCHANGED, from: true, to: true}. The flash: "Already on. Nothing changed."
evidenceRef: A4ConsolesServiceTest#switching a flag writes it and a FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED row, and to its own value is UNCHANGED, nothing written to it

reason: The row is written enabled, FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED SUCCEEDED {from: false, to: true}; its job asks again from its next run. A reminder or push that fell due while off is not sent later.
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a flag switched off on the page is off for every reader at once, and on again restores them

reason: Nothing is written to the flag; FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED REFUSED {result: UNCHANGED}. The flash: "Already off. Nothing changed."
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a flag switched off on the page is off for every reader at once, and on again restores them

reason: As from DEFAULT_ON: the row is updated disabled, FEATURE_FLAG_CHANGED SUCCEEDED {from: true, to: false}.
evidenceRef: FeatureFlagStoreTest#a written row wins, and every read sees the table as it is now
codeRef: modules/admin/src/main/kotlin/com/moyi/admin/infra/FeatureFlagStore.kt#ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled

when: the id names no ticket, or is not a UUID
reason: The admin 404 page, the same bytes as any unknown page. The function writes no READ; one SUPPORT_TICKET_READ row, REFUSED, {result: NOT_FOUND} (a value that is not a UUID writes nothing).
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a close outside the window asks for a code and closes nothing, and an unknown ticket is the 404 page
codeRef: modules/admin/src/main/kotlin/com/moyi/admin/service/SupportConsole.kt#metadata = if (case != null) emptyMap() else mapOf(RESULT to NOT_FOUND)

reason: A member's support message (POST /api/v1/support/messages, its own rows in account.md) creates the ticket OPEN with its subject, message and reference; the inbox lists it with lengths only, never the words.
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a SUPPORT session lists without the words, reads with them, and closes inside the window

reason: The page shows the words, the reference, the address to answer at as identity holds it now, and whether it was confirmed. The function writes READ under admin:<id>; one SUPPORT_TICKET_READ row, SUCCEEDED.
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a SUPPORT session lists without the words, reads with them, and closes inside the window

when: a code proven in the last five minutes, and a note
reason: The function closes it and deletes the words and reference, CLOSED log row with the note; one SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED row, SUCCEEDED, {result: CLOSED}. The flash: "Closed. Its words are gone." Before the act: the step-up window (stale: the form asking for a code, nothing read or written), then the note (refused: the form again, 400).
evidenceRef: A4ConsolesServiceTest#a close inside the step-up window empties the ticket, a second is NOT_OPEN, and both rows carry the note
codeRef: modules/admin/src/main/kotlin/com/moyi/admin/web/SupportInboxController.kt#const val CLOSED = "Closed. Its words are gone."

reason: Nothing changes; SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED REFUSED {result: NOT_OPEN}. The flash: "Already closed. Nothing changed." (Also the answer for an id that names no ticket: the function cannot tell.)
evidenceRef: A4PagesTest#a SUPPORT session lists without the words, reads with them, and closes inside the window

reason: Erasure closes the sender's open tickets and empties them (ADR-0057 decision 8); a close from the console afterwards is NOT_OPEN.
evidenceRef: EmptyDeletedAccountTicketsTest#every open ticket of the person is closed and emptied, logged as the deletion's, and nobody else's is touched
